selected_reference.author: 有序静物摄影
selected_reference.selection_reason: Best controlled single-plate lighting and material hierarchy; use as learning reference, not literal replication.
distilled_visual_mechanisms: One plated food hero with clear negative space rather than a full ingredient inventory.
Warm brown background, with separate luminance control for background versus food.
Large soft side/back key light creates dimensional food texture; modest reflector fill recovers shadows.
Irregular ceramic, dark wood and textured cloth add tactile context without competing with the dish.
Shallow, controlled depth of field and restrained prop count.
selected_reference.intended_original_output: Original photo of a Chinese home-style dish (green pepper pork stir-fry) on a dark rustic ceramic plate, warm earth-toned tabletop and one softly side-lit hero, distinct from the reference dish and composition; no text, logos, watermarks.
selected_reference.generation_constraints: One image only, no retries, no external paid image APIs, no typography, no Figma.
